text:
maria: quick sync idea 1: micro launch test for next cohort. give 20 starter credits + 3 tiny prompts + short webinar invite. goal: first-use in <24h and measurable lift in retention.
ashley: nice. split creative into 'code' vs 'copy' lanes so it's targeted.
jon: seg by 'signup_intent' field and route to prompt pack. embed users -> embedding pack.
sam: ops: ensure credits auto-expire at 7d and throttle new accounts to 75 rpm.
maria: cadence draft: 0h email+credits, 6h in-app nudge, 18h reminder+webinar invite, 48h last-chance.
ashley: subject lines to A/B test: "20 credits to try Redwood" vs "Try these 3 prompts (3 mins)".
jon: metrics: activation = first_success event; track cost per activated user.
maria: infra checklist: create flag welcome_micro_v2, wire events: credits_granted, prompt_used, first_success, webinar_registered. tag model_name + variant.
growth-bot: experiment created welcome_micro_v2 id: exp_20260415_9. traffic: 10% initial, ramp rules set.
sam: rollout: Fri 8am PT 10% -> monitor 24h -> ramp to 35% if healthy. alert if first_success <25% or cost/activation > $1.
ashley: deliverables: email A/B, in-app copy, 3 prompt texts with seed inputs, 20s demo gif for embed lane.
maria: i'll drop prompt drafts here by Thu EOD. keep comments short so we can move quick.
ashley: :rocket:
maria: thanks all.
